pyramiding_rule: Absolute prohibition against opening multiple sequential tickets in the same direction within a 120-second window to prevent stacked liquidation clusters.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: ATR(14) volatility expansion coefficient must exceed 1.2 x baseline, and Order Book bid-ask imbalance must favor direction by >65% prior to execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of position at +$10.00, lock remaining volume at breakeven +$2.00, and enforce hard trailing stop until target +$25.00 is reached.
